name: dprint
description: Skill /dprint:dprint with init (checks for a minimum dprint version, installs or updates dprint at user level after confirmation, offers to create a dprint config and to add dprint plugins for file types the project's dprint config does not cover), check [scope] and fmt [scope] (dprint check / dprint fmt on the current directory or a given path or glob; no argument runs fmt). Also formats every Write and Edit with the project's dprint config via a PreToolUse hook when the working directory has a dprint config, and shows a toast when it has none (MCP server dprint-hooks; needs node and dprint >= 0.50 on PATH).
